description:
Mujin is the future of industrial robotic systems in production and distribution environments. Our technology gives robots perception and awareness, enabling them to take on advanced tasks beyond simple pick-and-place. We aim to revolutionize robotics in industry, freeing human resources from labor-intensive work to focus on intellectual challenges.  

 
 


 As a Software Developer for Robotics at  Mujin , you will design and implement  cutting-edge  algorithms for real-time motion planning,  perception , and control of industrial robots and grippers. You will develop  cutting-edge  robotics technology, including the design, implementation, and testing of algorithms that run on  numerous  robots in real time. You will test and deploy your work in simulation and the real world on various off-the-shelf and in-house robotics hardware.   

     

 Within that scope, you will specialize in gripper technology, where robotics  stops  being  simulation  and  starts  being physics: vacuum and airflow, seal quality, load balance, and hardware that wears. You will model that physics in production C++ and Python and close the loop back into motion planning and grasp selection. The work spans real-time control against industrial IO and sensors, calibration and fault-diagnosis pipelines, bench experiments, and production data from customer sites. This role is ideal for someone passionate about robotics, automation, and pushing the boundaries of intelligent systems.   

   

 Position Description :    

 
 Design, develop, and test advanced robotics software for motion planning, kinematics, and real-time control of robot arms and grippers.     

 
 
 Design and run bench experiments on real gripper hardware to characterize behavior and  validate  models.   

 
 
 Design and  maintain  pipelines for gripper calibration and fault diagnosis.   

 
 
 Architect and  optimize  software systems for industrial automation environments.    

 
 
 Integrate  Mujin’s  “ Teachless ” technology with major industrial robot arms (Fanuc, Yaskawa, ABB, etc.).    

 
 
 Write production-quality code that runs in real-time. Deploy solutions in simulation and real-world environments  at  scale .   

 
 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless  hardware-software  integration.    

 
 
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in deployed systems.    

 
 
 Other duties as assigned   

 
   

 Position  Requirements:   

 
 Bachelor's or  Master's degree in Computer Science , Robotics,  Physics  or  a related  field.   

 
 
 Experience with Linux development environments  and programming in C++ and  python .   

 
 
 Expertise  in 3D motion planning and robot kinematics.   

 
 
 Solid understanding of math and physics fundamentals related to robotics  manipulation  and gripper control.   

 Familiarity with industrial robot arms (Fanuc, Yaskawa, ABB). 


 
 



 Preferred Qualifications:   

 
 2+ years of experience using Python and C++ for high-performance applications .   

 
 
 Expertise  in robotic motion planning, grasp planning, and gripper control.   

 
 
 Experience with fluid mechanics and pneumatics, including vacuum generation and manifold pressure dynamics.   

 
 
 Ability to build and  validate  lumped-parameter dynamic models.   

 
 
 Comfort with probabilistic and statistical modeling of physical processes.   

 
 
 Experience with real-time systems and distributed architecture.   

 
 
 Experience with robotics, industrial automation, and warehouse systems.   

 
 
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices.   

 
 



 Physical Demands / Work Environment :     

 
 Travel Requirement: Road Warrior. Willing to travel  a bou t   60 % of the year as required by project d emands   

 
 
 Work in both office and warehouse/manufacturing environments     

 
 
 Ability to work extended hours as required by project deliveries
